reviewBoundary: Catalog source excerpts and row foci were checked against the authorized original scans. The row-to-item mappings are from the visually reviewed source-first manifest. This patch does not edit catalog data fields, source-value grades, citation-overrides.json, shared citation contracts, or ledger review records; parent must review/apply target reference and field-binding proposals and supersede old hash-bound findings explicitly.

wrongTableIdentityFindings.visualFinding: The row crop visibly contains the PHB p.38 Hand Held Spear row (length 5′–13′+, space 1′, speed 6–8 and hand-held AC adjustments). It is on the same printed page and source PDF page, but is not the Hurled Weapons and Missiles Spear row.
wrongTableIdentityFindings.initialDetectorOutcome: Page/book/source-hash plus required-region-presence logic would accept the Hand Held row as satisfying the missile row; table identity was not represented in the initial requiredRegionId contract.

tableIdentityMethod: Every confirmed target contract carries requiredTableImageSha256 for the exact printed source table image and requiredRegionIds limited to row regions of that image. Optional companion contexts are recorded separately and do not satisfy or pollute the required table-image identity check. Each row catalog region carries exact sourceTableId metadata as an additional human-readable identity tag. Same-page presence alone is not accepted.

tableIdentityCheck.checkedBy: manual binding/region/hash integrity replay after catalog edits

validation.sourceValues: No source-value grades were changed; fieldBindingProposals are proposals only.

sourcePixelReview.basis: Authorized PHB and DMG original PDFs plus complete, hash-identified limited table crops. Row-focus overlays were generated only in /tmp and inspected to compare source labels, value columns and marked qualifiers; no full-page source image/PDF was copied into the repository.
